title: Keep design-system files out of the app's CSS build
summary: Adds `@source not "../../design-system";` to globals.css so Tailwind no longer scans the design-system folder (viewer specimens, previews, experiments, release snapshots) when building the app's CSS. Today about ten unused utility classes from those files end up in the app stylesheet; with this they cannot.
migration: No visual change. If a future app file ever imports from design-system/ (it should not), its classes would need an explicit @source.
